description: This file defines the ShiftAssignment class and related functions for managing employee shift schedules, including validation, event retrieval, and shift timing calculations within an HR management system.

classes.name: ShiftAssignment
classes.description: Represents an employee's shift assignment with validation and overlap checking.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the shift assignment, including active employee check and date overlaps.

methods.name: validate_overlapping_dates
methods.description: Checks for overlapping shift assignments for the same employee.

methods.name: throw_overlap_error
methods.description: Raises an error if overlapping shift assignments are detected.
